alignment_method: Measured 2026-10-11 from two side-on photos of the lamp holding its powered home pose (motion/config/v2/poses.yaml home: shoulder 0.308, elbow -0.256, head_pitch -0.14). Image vertical checked against the monitor edge (<0.2 deg). Link directions taken through the shoulder, elbow and head-pitch axis centres; head direction from the diffuser rim. Model angles at home: shoulder -0.810, elbow +1.244, head_pitch -0.210 rad; reference = home - model. Uncertainty about +/-1.5 deg per joint. Base yaw and head roll are not observable from a side view and stay 0. The V2 URDF's all-zero pose is an upright arm with the head facing forward.
reference_formula: model_angle = calibrated_angle - joint_reference; Studio applies this offset only to the 3D preview.
